mss: Compliance with standard occupational safety regarding toxic gas exposure (H2S continuous detection), community health buffer zones, and fair labor.

activity: Coal-Fired Power Plant Early Retirement & Managed Phase-Out
tsc: Binding early retirement date legally enacted prior to 2040. Minimum 20% co-firing with verified sustainable biomass. No new coal capacity expansion allowed.
dnsh: Air pollutant concentration monitoring for SO2, NOx, and particulate matter (PM2.5). Fly ash and bottom ash (FABA) safely recycled or managed under non-hazardous protocols.
mss: Equitable transition framework ensuring re-skilling or severance packages for local workforce without unilateral mass layoffs.

activity: Electricity Generation from Solar Photovoltaic and Wind Turbines
tsc: Direct operational GHG emissions must equal 0g CO2e/kWh. Power purchase agreement (PPA) connected to regional grid or off-grid mini-grids replacing diesel gensets.
dnsh: Decommissioning plan and recycling contract for end-of-life solar PV modules and wind turbine composite blades.
mss: Free, Prior, and Informed Consent (FPIC) obtained from customary indigenous communities regarding land acquisition.

activity: Green Asset Ratio and Sustainable Lending Portfolio
tsc: Minimum 20% of total commercial loan and bond investment portfolio allocated to OJK POJK 51/2017 eligible Sustainable Business Activities (KKUB). Zero project financing for new greenfield unabated coal mines.
dnsh: Implementation of mandatory ESG Risk Assessment for commercial corporate financing above IDR 10 billion.
mss: Enforcement of comprehensive environmental & social exclusion list (child labor, illegal deforestation, hazardous waste dumping).

mss: Stringent occupational safety standards in high-heat pyrometallurgical zones.

mss: Free, Prior, and Informed Consent (FPIC) with local customary communities and plasma smallholder empowerment programs.

mss: Sanitation worker personal protective equipment (PPE) protocols and biochemical exposure monitoring.
